method: Full non-merge history is retained. Candidate discovery uses title terms fix/correct/preserve/recover/restore/harden/reject/prevent. Candidate discovery can omit differently titled fixes and overcount maintenance; therefore no all-fixes percentage is claimed. Entries marked reviewed have added regression assertions linked to the changed code. Dependency-only updates are not automatically counted as bug fixes. Additional content review includes fixes missed by title filtering and explicitly includes installation, CI authentication and dependency-lock defects. A commit can contain several defects; reviewed commit-pair counts are not the denominator of all corrected defects.
